items.title: Mona Hinton interviewed by Milt Fillius and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995
items.q: Lou Rawls and Billy Eckstine and Joe did a trio

ctx.x: Well, Mona, we’re coming up on 5:30, that’s an hour. And we’ve enjoyed — the nice things about the stories you tell about Milt is that those of us who know you both know that he couldn’t be what he is without you.

Yeah. I have to tell you something about, you know I’ve been knowing Joe for many years too, and Jillean, she’s a lovely person, but one of the nicest renditions I think that I remember of Joe Williams is at the White House, for Duke Ellington’s 70th birthday that they had there, and Lou Rawls and Billy Eckstine and Joe did a trio. And it was fabulous. If you ever get a chance, you know you should see it.
Of course he and Billy Eckstine were great friends.
